arm_definitions.flat_reject_retry: Inspect the same candidates in frozen order. Reject any failed constraint and accept the first fully valid candidate.
arm_definitions.selective_priority: Preserve a valid base byte string. Otherwise choose the exact hard-binding-soft lexicographic minimum with a stable index tie.

field_principles.acceptance_gate_positive: Predeclared conjunction for a positive effect claim.
field_principles.arm_definitions: The selective and flat policies compared on each candidate set.
field_principles.attack_results: Deterministic attacks on priority, features, certificates, and budgets.
field_principles.budget_match_receipt: Evidence that both arms receive equal permissions and work.
field_principles.certificate_completeness_by_arm: Held first-conflict or no-op certificate coverage.
field_principles.compiler_artifact_sha256: SHA-256 of the Exp6811 compiler artifact.
field_principles.false_intervention_rate_by_arm: Held changes to proposals already known to be valid.
field_principles.feature_allowlist: Proposal-time fields that selection may read.
field_principles.feature_denylist: Identity, outcome, and utility labels denied to selection.
field_principles.field_principles: One plain-language principle for every top-level field.
field_principles.frozen_manifest: Development and held splits, budgets, and public constants.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Named precondition checks with expected and observed values.
field_principles.harmful_selections_by_arm: Held selections that fail the external exact transition check.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal statement that reports positive, null, or blocked evidence.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Deterministic CPU replay of frozen bytes with no model call.
field_principles.legal_support_by_arm: Held legal selections and model-family support.
field_principles.manifest_receipt: Checks that the split and constants were frozen before reduction.
field_principles.random_seed: Frozen seeds for stable ties and paired intervals.
field_principles.reducer_receipt: Checks that held reduction is deterministic and row-derived.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash that binds source, manifest, and deterministic rows.
field_principles.retry_cost_by_arm: Held realized retry cost under equal retry caps.
field_principles.safe_action_identity_by_arm: Held byte identity for already-valid base proposals.
field_principles.selective_arbiter_ab_completed: Downstream completion independent of effect sign.
field_principles.source_artifact_sha256: SHA-256 of the authentic Exp6812 proposal artifact.
field_principles.title: Human-readable experiment name.
field_principles.verdict_class: Closed terminal class supported by rows and gates.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False because the outcome evaluator runs after both selectors.
